title: Only 70 Right Whale Mothers Stand Between Recovery And Collapse
hook: A hopeful calf rebound still depends on very few mothers.
closing: The species can recover only if its small group of breeding females survives.
question: Can right whales recover?

segments.say: Right whales reached 384 animals, a rebound that still leaves the species dangerously small.
That small population produced 22 calves, showing recovery remains possible.
But only 70 right whales are breeding females, so losing a few can stall the comeback.
